# Guest functions whose A57 code is cheaper WITHOUT the loop / leaf locals (tools/locals_choice.py,
# 2026-10-16; marathon-nx proposal 3). One per line: "<tool> <DEFINE_REX_FUNC name>", tool = loop
# (tools/loop_locals.py: REX_LOOP_LOCAL) or leaf (tools/leaf_locals.py: REX_LEAF_LOCAL).
# Rule: every generated file with locals compiled twice with the Switch build's command line, as
# built and with -DREX_LOOP_LOCALS_OFF -DREX_LEAF_LOCALS_OFF; per function (objdump -dr) the
# loop-weighted cost sum(w * (1 + is_mem)), w = 10 for an instruction in a loop, else 1;
# loops = cycles of the control-flow graph (jump tables read);
# code that only runs after a call of ppc_trap (GCC's copies into the trap path) left out.
# Listed when the off form is cheaper by more than 2.0 % of the on form: 296 of 6073 functions
# with locals, on - off = +350789. Static counts of the compiled code, not run-time samples.
